name: 깃펜 필사실
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, quiet scriptorium chamber with a long wooden desk holding rows of feather quills and glass ink bottles, a half-written parchment drying beside a squat candle, stacked blank scrolls at the desk edge, warm amber candlelight mixing with cool teal moonlight through a slatted window, three-quarter interior view leaving generous open floor space, soft ink-stained textures, richly detailed fantasy concept art.
